"""One campaign that pushes several documented bounds at the same time."""
import json, random, struct, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import kit

rng = random.Random(3)
ENTRIES = 16
RUNS = 1200
TYPES = []
MODULES = []

TYPES.append({"name": "B", "kind": "bool"})
TYPES.append({"name": "C", "kind": "char"})
TYPES.append({"name": "M", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 100})
TYPES.append({"name": "ST", "kind": "enum",
              "values": ["S%d" % i for i in range(512)]})
TYPES.append({"name": "I64", "kind": "int", "bits": 64})

# nested aggregates: struct of arrays of structs
TYPES.append({"name": "I20", "kind": "int", "bits": 20})
TYPES.append({"name": "IN", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["a", "I20"], ["b", "C"]]})
TYPES.append({"name": "IA", "kind": "array", "element": "IN", "size": 8})
TYPES.append({"name": "IB", "kind": "alias", "target": "IA"})
TYPES.append({"name": "AL", "kind": "array", "element": "I20", "size": 0})

PATTERN = "[a-c][0-8]([x-z]|(ab|cd)*)*"


def build(i):
    TYPES.append({"name": "T%d" % i, "kind": "int", "bits": 8 + (i % 40)})
    TYPES.append({"name": "U%d" % i, "kind": "array", "element": "T%d" % i,
                  "size": 60})
    MODULES.append({"name": "E%02d" % i,
                    "params": [["p%d" % j, "U%d" % i] for j in range(2)] +
                              [["st", "ST"], ["msg", "M"], ["x", "IB"], ["z", "AL"]],
                    "result": ["r", "IN"],
                    "requires": ["and",
                                 ["match", ["var", "msg"], PATTERN],
                                 ["lt", ["index", ["field", ["var", "x"], 0], 1],
                                  ["var", "n"]] if False else
                                 ["lt", ["index", ["field", ["var", "x"], 0], 1],
                                  ["const", "T%d" % i, 5]]]})
    MODULES.append({"name": "H%02d" % i, "params": [["a", "T%d" % i]],
                    "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": None})
    MODULES.append({"name": "F%02d" % i, "params": [["q", "M"]],
                    "result": ["r", "B"], "requires": ["ne", ["var", "q"],
                                                       ["const", "M", "zz"]]})


for i in range(ENTRIES):
    build(i)

CALLS = []
PIPES = []
for i in range(ENTRIES):
    CALLS.append(["E%02d" % i, "H%02d" % i])
    PIPES.append({"target": "E%02d" % i, "filter": "F%02d" % i,
                  "bind": {"q": "msg"}})
    PIPES.append({"target": "F%02d" % i, "filter": "F%d" % ((i + 1) % ENTRIES),
                  "bind": {"q": "q"}})

transitions = []
for i in range(16384):
    frm = rng.randrange(512)
    to = rng.randrange(512)
    item = {"from": "S%d" % frm, "to": "S%d" % to, "command": "k%05d" % i,
            "cost": rng.randint(1, 65535)}
    item["when"] = (["ge", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", i]] if False else
                    (["ge", ["field", ["var", "x"], "a"], ["const", "T0", 0]]
                     if i < 1024 else None))
    transitions.append(item)
MODULES.append({"name": "NREF", "params": [["n", "N"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                "requires": None})
TYPES.append({"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 16})
machine = {"states": ["S%d" % i for i in range(512)], "initial": "S0",
           "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": transitions}

campaign = {"types": TYPES, "modules": MODULES, "calls": CALLS, "pipes": PIPES,
            "entries": ["E%02d" % i for i in range(ENTRIES)],
            "machine": machine, "runs": []}

start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("plans %6.2fs" % (time.time() - start))
plans = {p["entry"]: p for p in out["plans"]}
total_slots = sum(len(p["slots"]) for p in out["plans"])
total_ids = sum(p["variables"] for p in out["plans"])
print("slots", total_slots, "ids", total_ids)

runs = []
for i in range(RUNS):
    entry = plans["E%02d" % (i % ENTRIES)]
    plan = entry
    values = []
    for j in range(2):
        values.extend([1] * 60)          # U elements (60 each)
    values.append(i % 512)               # st
    chars = [97 + (i % 3)] + [48 + (j % 9) for j in range(1 + (i % 40))]
    values.extend([ord(c) for c in chars] + [0] * (100 - len(chars)))
    # x: IB = alias to array of 8 structs of (a: int20, b: char)
    for k in range(8):
        values.extend([k, 65 + k])
    values.append(0)                     # z: empty array (no leaves)
    values.extend([7, 66])               # result struct
    objs = [(n, kit.leaf(w, v)) for (n, p, w), v in zip(plan["slots"], values)]
    objs.append((plan["flag"], b"\x00"))
    runs.append({"entry": plan["entry"], "ktest": kit.encode(objs)})
print("objects", sum(len(r) for r in [[o for o in [1]]]), "runs", len(runs))
campaign["runs"] = runs
data = json.dumps(campaign)
print("input MiB %.1f build %.1fs" % (len(data) / 2 ** 20, time.time() - start))
start = time.time()
out = kit.run_cli(campaign)
print("full campaign %6.2fs" % (time.time() - start))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print("corpus", len(out["corpus"]),
      "max commands", max((len(c["commands"]) for c in out["corpus"]), default=0),
      "max cost", max((c["cost"] for c in out["corpus"]), default=0))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 t_big.py 2>&1 | tail -12
